about_the_game:
The Legacy Demo is a demo version of a cooperative survival horror game where you can try out part of the full game for free, experience the spirit of cooperative adventure, survival, world exploration and conquer the darkness.

🎮 A bit about the demo:

  • some portion of avatars for your character;

  • a small part of unique badges, which you will get for increasing the level of your character;

  • 4 characters to choose from;

  • only a part of the game world will be available in the game, you will be able to explore about 1/4 of Svetlograd and its surroundings;

  • the balance of some events in the game - will be changed, as the size of the world is smaller, and the entire balance of the game will be adjusted to it;

  • in the demo you will have access to 2 dark entities, one cycle of the game will be passed as soon as you expel one of them (this is not a simple task, so it will require attention, reaction speed and preferably support friends);

  • Merchant will give only part of the tasks, as well as - sell a small part of the items available in the full game;

  • loot crates, which are sometimes dropped by the airplane - will fall a little less often and with less unique loot;

  • most of the pages for Molfar's book will be unavailable;

  • the military's secret bunker will be closed;

In 1990 a curse fell on our hometown, our grandfather, a local molfar and magician, according to the ominous tradition - once in 66 years should sacrifice one of his descendants to the dark forest forces, but he could not do it, so he sent me, my two brothers and sister to Kiev to protect us from the curse. He saved our lives, but doomed the city and its surroundings to death and destruction.

Years passed, we have already become adults and built our own lives, but the memory of Svetlograd tormented our hearts. At one of the family dinners - we made a decision to return there and end the darkness forever, to free the city and give people the opportunity to live normally. Each of us has our own unique skills, strengths and weaknesses, so we complement each other perfectly. After gathering some gear - we headed out there, to meet...

🛠️ Survival

  The Legacy Demo - has a detailed survival system, your character will need food, water, the cold climate of the autumn Carpathians - will force you to make a fire to keep warm, move more, or find shelter on a cold night. Also, your stamina depends on which character you've chosen and how full your backpack is. A bottle of energy drink or a shot of adrenaline can help you avoid stamina problems for a while.

When you run out of food and there is no gas station or other place where you can find food nearby - catch and cook carp, or hunt down and kill a wild animal to cook juicy meat on the fire, in the oven or in a cauldron. Also, don't forget about mushrooms and apples.

⚗️ Potions, Magic and Mysticism

Svetlograd is not just a town, and the settlements around it are not just small villages. Many local legends tell about mysticism, dark and light magic and mythical entities, so the inhabitants are not simple. That's why in The Legacy Demo - you will find recipes of magic potions, information about dark entities and how to fight them, about rituals. Collect herbs, mushrooms and other ingredients. You will have the opportunity to learn the local mythology and fight evil, with guns and bullets, or with rituals and potions.

🌲 Large open world, different locations

The Legacy Demo features a small open world where you can explore different locations, while completing tasks and surviving. While exploring the game world - you will find notes of locals, which will tell you various mystical stories about Svetlograd and its surroundings.

Also, when you start a new game - all game items (food, weapons, ammo, book pages, enemies, plants, mushrooms, animals, etc.) - appear in random places, it gives you the opportunity - to play each time a truly new and unique game, with an unpredictable ending.

🛠️ Construction, resource extraction and item creation

If You have tools, such as an axe or a knife, you can extract various resources, but if you don't have tools - try to break sticks with your bare hands, but be careful - you can easily cut yourself, then you will need bandages. Obtained resources - you can use them to create various items, as well as to build your own house or base, camp. In a team - building a camp or a house is faster, when one player extracts resources, the second builds, and the third builds a fire and prepares food, so that after building a camp - you can start cooking a delicious dinner and replenish your strength before new adventures.

🔑 Key features:

  • Ability to play in a team of up to 4 people or alone;

  • the opportunity to meet and fight with different mythical creatures;

  • interesting and dangerous open world;

  • animal hunting, fishing;

  • each mythical creature has its own unique attacks and behavioral peculiarities;

  • pumping unique badges;

  • the ability to play on 100+ servers simultaneously, play with friends or strangers;

  • voice and text chat;

  • the ability to choose a unique avatar from the list of available avatars;

  • construction system, build your own base or camp from improvised means;

  • the atmosphere of mysticism of Western Ukraine and the abandoned town of Svetlograd and the surrounding area;

  • detailed survival mechanics - the ability to get wet, if you stay in the rain for a long time, the character freezes faster until he warms up by the fire or dries out. Hunger, thirst, temperature, stamina, blood and cuts, infections, curses cast, the ability to brew and drink potions to get rid of curses or heal wounds, and more;

  • many crafting recipes;

  • the ability to collect recipes, ingredients and brew potions, perform rituals to banish dark forces;

  • sail a boat, fish, hunt, cook food on the fire or in the oven, help each other, share resources, explore the huge game world;

  • every new game - loot (game items) - appear in random places, with a certain probability, enemies behave differently, mythical creatures appear differently;

  • at the beginning of the game - you have ordinary equipment, weak weapons, but if you carefully explore the world - you can find a variety of weapons, meet the military, with a fairly advanced artificial intelligence and fight with them.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4430
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 760 or AMD R9 270X
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX®-compatible
  • Additional Notes: Internet connection, SSD is highly recommended or expect longer than average load times.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-4790K / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: RTX 3060 / RX 570 Series or better
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Internet connection, SSD is highly recommended or expect longer than average load times.

short_description: The Legacy Demo is a cooperative survival horror game. You and your siblings return to your cursed homeland, facing darkness and danger. Will you survive and stop the evil? Your skills and teamwork are key to overcoming the challenges that await you...
supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Portuguese - Brazil, Spanish - Latin America, Simplified Chinese, Polish, Russian, Turkish, Ukrainian
